interest: Index on rumors of a Japanese naval base in Mexico.
overview: Docket (1931-38): rumors of Japanese naval bases in Lower California, with State declining a private observation cruise.

subfiles.about: A State Department docket sheet indexing correspondence and reports from 1931 to 1938 regarding alleged Japanese coaling and naval stations in Mexico.
subfiles.summary: Lists 1931-38 reports on rumored Japanese naval bases in Lower California/Gulf of California, and State's refusal of private observation cruise.
subfiles.title: Department of State List of Papers: Coaling Stations of Japan in Mexico
